app.name: Dewiride Analytics
app.description: Web analytics that tells you which of your visitors are people.

setup.title: Welcome to Dewiride Analytics
setup.subtitle: Set up your account and your first website. It takes about a minute.

password.label: Password
password.hint: At least 15 characters. A few unrelated words work well.

organisation.label: Organisation
organisation.hint: Your company, your blog, or your own name.

claimed.title: This installation already has an owner
claimed.body: Sign in with the account that was created, or ask whoever set it up to invite you.

refused.title: We couldn't sign you in
refused.body: Check your email address and password, then try again. Several wrong attempts in a row will pause sign-in for a few minutes.

visitors.label: Daily visitors
visitors.note: Someone who returns tomorrow counts again.

chart.title: Traffic
chart.days: Days run midnight to midnight in {zone}.
chart.summary: Daily page views and daily visitors for {site} over the selected period.
chart.table: Show these figures as a table

pages.title: Pages
pages.total: {count, plural, one {# page view} other {# page views}}

empty.title: No pages read yet
empty.body: Once somebody opens a page, the ones people read most appear here.

locations.title: Where your readers are
locations.mostlyUnplaced: Most visits arrived without an address to place. That usually means something sits in front of Dewiride Analytics and isn't passing the visitor's address along.
locations.estimate: Towns are an estimate — usually the nearest sizeable one.

empty.title: No readers placed yet
empty.body: Once somebody visits, the countries and towns they read from appear here.

devices.title: What your readers use
devices.mostlyUnknown: Most visits carried nothing that names a device. Who's visiting, further down, says what they were.

empty.title: No devices seen yet
empty.body: Once somebody visits, what they read on appears here.

typical.label: Typical time on a page
typical.note: Counted only while the page was actually on screen.

interacted.label: Readers who did something
interacted.note: Clicked, tapped or typed at least once.

unmeasured.title: Nothing here could be measured
unmeasured.body: Nothing that reached your site this period ran the code on your pages. That is normal for crawlers, and for anything your own server reported.

empty.title: No pages read yet
empty.body: Once somebody reads a page, how long they stayed and how far they got appears here.

traffic.title: Who's visiting
traffic.judged: {count, plural, one {# visit judged} other {# visits judged}}
traffic.pending: Visits still under way aren't counted here yet.

empty.title: Nothing judged yet
empty.body: A visit is judged once it has finished, so the first ones appear about half an hour after they end.

visits.title: Recent visits
visits.caption: The last {count, plural, one {visit} other {# visits}} to finish. Open one to see the pages it went through, what people clicked, and what it was judged on.

empty.title: Waiting for your first visit
empty.body: Nothing has reached {site} yet. As soon as it does, it shows up here.

noSites.title: No website yet
noSites.body: Add a website to this account and its traffic will appear here.

flow.title: How people move through your site
flow.caption: {count, plural, one {# visit that has finished} other {# visits that have finished}}

perVisit.label: Pages per visit
perVisit.note: Counted per sitting, not per person.

empty.title: No finished visits yet
empty.body: Once somebody has been round your site and moved on, where they arrived and where they left appears here.

journey.title: What happened in this visit
journey.unwatched: Nothing here ran the code on your pages, so how long each one held anybody is unknown.
journey.empty: Nothing was recorded for this visit.
journey.failed: This visit could not be loaded.

caption.destination: {count, plural, one {# click that led off your site} other {# clicks that led off your site}}

none.control: Nothing was clicked in this period.
none.destination: Nobody has followed a link away from your site yet.

empty.title: No clicks yet
empty.body: Once somebody uses a link or a button on one of your pages, it appears here with how often it was clicked.

reasons.other: Something else about this visit pointed that way.

declared_crawler.aiTraining: It called itself {token}, a crawler {operator} uses to train AI models.
declared_crawler.aiAssistant: It called itself {token}, a crawler {operator} uses to answer people's questions.
declared_crawler.aiSearch: It called itself {token}, a crawler {operator} uses to build AI search results.
declared_crawler.searchIndex: It called itself {token}, a crawler {operator} uses to build search results.
declared_crawler.advertising: It called itself {token}, a crawler {operator} uses for advertising.
declared_crawler.siteTooling: It called itself {token}, a tool {operator} uses to check websites.
declared_crawler.unstated: It called itself {token}, a crawler run by {operator}.

identity.unverified_claim: Any visitor can claim that name. We have not checked it against the addresses that company publishes, so this is what it says it is.

declared_tool.headlessBrowser: It named itself as a browser running with nobody watching it.
declared_tool.script: It named itself as a program fetching pages rather than as a browser.
declared_tool.scrapingFramework: It named itself as a tool built for copying whole websites.
declared_tool.commandLine: It named itself as a download tool rather than as a browser.
declared_tool.other: It named itself as software rather than as a browser.

identity.no_user_agent: It did not say what it was. Every ordinary browser does.

read_time.seconds: Your pages were open in front of somebody for {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
read_time.minutes: Your pages were open in front of somebody for about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

engagement.scrolled: Somebody scrolled {percent}% of the way down a page.
engagement.pointer_used: A mouse or a finger was used on the page.
engagement.keyboard_used: A key was pressed on the page.
engagement.none_observed: Across {pageCount, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}, nothing was read, scrolled or touched.

retrieval.rate: It took {pageCount, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} at around {perMinute} a minute, far faster than anyone reads.
retrieval.breadth: It worked through {pageCount, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} in a single visit.

probing.missing_paths: It asked for {missingCount, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} that do not exist, out of {pageCount} it tried.
probing.sensitive_paths: It went looking for {attemptCount, plural, one {# place} other {# places}} where websites keep passwords and settings.

automation.declared_web_driver: The browser said outright that software was driving it.
automation.no_script_execution: Something on your side saw the visit and your tracking code never ran.

browser.script_executed: A real browser ran your tracking code.
browser.images_only: Pictures on the page were fetched but nothing was run — a browser with scripts turned off.
browser.no_language_declared: It did not say which language it prefers. Browsers always do.

problems.PasswordTooShort: That password is too short — use at least 15 characters.
problems.PasswordIsPredictable: That password is easy to guess. Try a few unrelated words instead.
problems.DuplicateEmail: An account already uses that email address.
problems.DuplicateUserName: An account already uses that email address.
problems.InvalidEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
problems.SiteDetailsRejected: We couldn't use that website address or time zone. Check both and try again.
problems.OrganizationNameRejected: We couldn't use that organisation name. Try a different one.
problems.SiteAlreadyMeasured: That website is already in your list — switch to it from the picker at the top.
problems.SiteNameRejected: We couldn't use that name. Try a shorter one.
problems.SiteTimeZoneRejected: We couldn't use that time zone. Pick another one from the list.
problems.SiteIsOnlyOne: This is your only website, so it can't be removed. Add another one first.

errors.unreachableBody: The connection didn't get through. Check that everything is running, then try again.
errors.unexpectedBody: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
errors.tooManyBody: Wait a few minutes, then try again.

validation.emailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
validation.organisationRequired: Enter a name for your organisation.

install.title: Your tracking code
install.body: Paste these two lines into {site} once, wherever your website keeps the things that show on every page. Most website builders have a box for it, usually called custom code or header.
install.next: Traffic starts appearing here as soon as somebody visits.

serverKeys.title: Server keys
serverKeys.body: Your tracking code counts visitors whose browser runs it. Crawlers and AI assistants usually don't run it. A server key lets {site}'s own server report those visits as well.

issued.title: Here is your key
issued.body: Copy it now. It is not shown again.

list.title: Keys in use
list.empty: Nothing is reporting from your server yet.

siteSettings.title: Settings
siteSettings.body: What {site} is called, when its days begin, and what gets measured.

timeZone.label: Count its days in
timeZone.hint: Pick where your readers are, not where you happen to be.

presses.label: Record what people click
presses.hint: Your own wording on the button or link is kept — never anything a visitor types.

removal.title: Remove this website
removal.body: Everything measured for {site} is deleted. There is no way to get it back.
